# Humaun Kabir

> AI/NLP engineer and researcher working on natural language processing, large language models, low-resource languages, and AI agents.

Humaun Kabir is an AI/NLP engineer and researcher with 5+ years of experience across R&D, industry, academia, and non-profit sectors. He completed his M.Sc. in Neural Networks and Neural Computers at the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology (MIPT) with distinction (Red Diploma). His research interests include text generation, text classification, LLMs for multimodal NLP, NLP for social good, and NLP applied to science. He is currently working on natural language processing, large language models, and AI agents for various applications.

This site is published in both HTML and LLM-friendly markdown. Both versions contain identical content; prefer the markdown versions for ingestion.

## Markdown Pages (preferred for ingestion)

- [Home (index.md)](https://ihumaun.com/index.md): Bio, updates, education, talks, fellowships, and leadership.
- [Past Experiences (pastexp.md)](https://ihumaun.com/static/html/pastexp.md): Past affiliations, media and newspaper articles, achievements, and curricular/co-curricular records.
